# Eternal Power & Cooling Services
> Authorized UPS OEM partner in Bangalore (since 2012). Supplies, installs, commissions and maintains UPS systems, battery banks, AMC, power quality and building infrastructure.

Website: https://www.eternalpower.co.in
Head office: Ground Floor, Site No. 161, NRI Layout Double Road, Kalkere, Horamavu (PO), Bangalore 560 043, Karnataka, India
Phone: +91 98418 88332
Phone: +91 78480 28878
Email: siva@eternalpower.co.in
Hours: Mon–Sat 9:30 AM – 6:30 PM; emergency breakdown support for AMC customers
